description.value: Atlin Lake Grocery Store is a supermarket serving Atlin, one of BC's most remote and isolated communities near the Yukon border, accessible only by a long gravel spur road off the Alaska Highway. For touring cyclists making the journey to Atlin, it is one of the only food resupply points in the region and a critical stop before or after the ride into town. The surrounding landscape — boreal wilderness, glaciers, and the striking Atlin Lake — makes this an extraordinary destination, and the store anchors the small townsite.
